title: Make repository environments ready and recoverable
what: Replace repeated ad hoc setup with reproducible repository environment provisioning, readiness checks and recoverable workspaces. Diagnose the live apt and git timeouts before selecting a fix; retain additional OS and self-hosted environment requirements in the parity inventory.

acceptance.text: A cold session reaches a verified clone and repository test run with required tools installed
Repeated setup or network failures become visible bounded waiting states
A restart preserves or restores verified workspace state without replaying unsafe writes
Warm-start and cold-start timings are measured with a regression check
Unsupported OS or infrastructure requirements are explicit and remain tracked
